The Ara project was attacked by a flash loan. The attackers are suspected to have made about $124,000 in BUSD. attacker address: 0xF84efA8a9F7E68855CF17EAaC9c2f97A9d131366.

Ara Finance suffered a $125,000 loss on BNB Chain in June 2023 when an attacker exploited excessive token approvals and weak access control in a swap contract. The incident involved flash loans, price manipulation, and leveraged contract permissions to drain user funds. The swap contract failed to restrict token transfers to strictly authorized users, allowing an attacker to use approvals from external addresses to swap tokens and extract value. Unlimited token allowances and inadequate access controls enabled the exploit.

Ara Protocol on BNB Chain lost about $125K on 2023-06-18 after an attacker combined a flash loan with a swap path that spent another wallet's allowances and ended with 124,915.758354 USDT in the attacker wallet. The swap contract accepted allowance-based token pulls without binding them to the caller's authority or limiting transfer size, so the attacker could spend a preapproved wallet's ARA and USDT during a flash-loan-funded price move.
